_provenance: Real build_standing_cost_disclosure output, captured 2026-08-21T16:33Z from one author's installation, and kept because a hand-written fixture would let the tests assert a shape the server does not produce. It is a payload shape, not a price list: read no cost claim off it. Two of its figures are known not to be representative. (1) The $11.40/day 'Databricks App compute' line predates this installation -- totals.installation excludes it, and the fairness paragraph does not, so that paragraph's 2.6x margin is inflated by a workspace cost the demo did not create. (2) The $14.80/day 'Round 4 synced-table pipeline' line is a CONTINUOUS synced table left running around the clock between bouts; a pipeline scheduled only for the bout window costs a fraction of it. That $14.80/day is not a second rate for that pipeline: it is the top of the meter's measured band, and OPEN-FINDINGS D20c settles the rate at $14.57/day +/-2% (1.349239 DBU/h x $0.45/DBU) with server/pipeline_power.py deriving it. Cite D20c rather than this capture. The AWS half ($10.12/day) is also superseded: Round 1's RDS instance has since been deleted and the live installation reads $8.35/day. Regenerate from a well-configured priced run before quoting anything here.
